While in Abu Dhabi covering the Asian Nations Chess Cup 2026, Devansh Singh visited the Abu Dhabi Chess Lovers group for an unforgettable evening of chess. What started with lighthearted, fun matches quickly turned into intense, high-stakes battles—ending with a special closing ceremony.
Check out the video to see how 7-year-old Ashwanth and 14-year-old Andria pulled off impressive wins against Devansh!
